fix_summary: Eviction condition in TTLCache.put uses '>' instead of '>=' so the cache is allowed to grow to max_entries + 1 before evicting. Change the condition to 'if len(self._entries) >= self.max_entries:' (ideally guarded by 'and key not in self._entries' to avoid evicting on updates).
suggested_test: Initialize TTLCache with max_entries=128. Insert 128 distinct keys and assert size()==128. Insert a 129th distinct key and assert size()==128 (the oldest was evicted). Also update an existing key when at capacity and assert size remains 128 and no unrelated key was evicted.
